01Integrateprovenance

A reference is four attributes and nothing else

The agent writes an empty details.ref carrying its attributes; the engine builds the summary, the chips and every href from #page-meta.provenance. This card carries one plain reference.

The group below covers the three other routes a reference can take: an archived copy on another branch, a file that lives only on a branch, and a site.

02Integratediff

The change marker lives in a CSS gutter

No glyph is typed into a line, so copied text is clean and the tint paints only the text cell.

- **Named recoverable failure** — claim the remainder.
- **De-hold** — the condition must stop holding.
- **User approval problem** — claim the remainder.
